name: ZARP Stablecoin
oneLiner: ZARP is a centralized South African Rand stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against ZAR cash reserves held in treasury at Old Mutual Wealth.
collateral: South African rand cash reserves held 1:1 in a treasury managed by Old Mutual Wealth, independently audited by Kempen Audit
pegMechanism: Mint/burn 1:1 with ZAR through ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd issuing partners; reserves may not be used for any purpose other than redemption

review.evidence: Role enumeration via Blockscout RoleGranted/RoleRevoked events plus hasRole confirmation at block 25295023. MINTER_ROLE = one EOA (0x37b1af), DEFAULT_ADMIN = one EOA (0xf50064), UPGRADER_ROLE = nobody currently (prior holder 0xfa4eb9 had all roles revoked). Same MINTER and ADMIN confirmed on Base and Polygon. Solana both SPL mints share one system-wallet mintAuthority. All addressable controls confirmed. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): Kempen Audit issued quarterly agreed-upon-procedures reports through 2026-02-27, published 2026-03-03, but the next expected quarterly report is overdue as of 2026-07-15; current recurring reconciliation is therefore not established. No exact prudential issuer authorization for ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd was established in FSCA's crypto-asset provider records. Reconciliation review (2026-08-08): the report the 2026-07-15 pass recorded as overdue has since been published - Kempen Audit Incorporated (Chartered Accountants SA, Registered Auditor) issued an ISRS 4400 agreed-upon-procedures report as of 2026-07-01 reconciling R91,205,857.45 at Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company and R1,144,210 at Standard Bank against 83,196,465.61 ZARP asserted in circulation, verifying supply directly on Ethereum, Solana, Base and Polygon. Nine such reports run from May 2024 to July 2026, so a recurring third-party reconciliation is established. Supervision remains non-prudential: ZARP Stablecoin (Pty) Ltd acts as a representative of Inves Capital (Pty) Ltd with a CASP licence still pending, and is explicitly not SARB-endorsed, so attestation-only.

reserveReview.rationale: Kempen Audit ISRS 4400 (Revised) AUP as of 1 July 2026 10:00 (PDF read this pass; expressly no opinion): AUP-verified balances of R91,205,857.45 at Old Mutual Wealth Trust Company (JHB) and R1,144,210 at Standard Bank (call+current), totalling R92,350,067.45 against 83,196,465.61 ZARP in circulation (gross on-chain 83,586,533 less treasury/frozen). NOTE: the attached management reserve report states a single unbroken total of ZAR 91,142,415.00 - a R1,207,652.45 gap versus the AUP-verified components that the document does not reconcile; percentages here use the AUP-verified figures. The single curated row carries the live single-asset adapter's slice identity (ZAR fiat reserves, 100%); the AUP-verified institution split (98.76% Old Mutual Wealth Trust / 1.24% Standard Bank) is recorded here rather than as separate rows so live classification is preserved.
